purpose: Make pattern calibration explicit after rev0022 surviving-anomaly positive-control pass.
global_rule: A pattern candidate earns maturity through controls, counterexamples, and rollback/split decisions, not record count alone.

entries.pattern_title: Numeric representation assumptions escaped their valid domain
entries.why_it_fits: Official inquiry report supports a litres/pounds/kilograms conversion-boundary pathway in an abnormal fueling workflow.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents MKH-PAT-0001 from being only a space/software-loss pattern; also shows that survivable recovery can coexist with a serious numeric-representation failure.
still_needed: negative control where numeric representation is present but not explanatory
caught-before-harm case where unit/range/precision error is intercepted before event
split decision between unit-conversion, range-overflow, precision-loss, and workflow subfamilies

entries.pattern_title: Correction memory does not equal correction infusion
entries.why_it_fits: Historical GAO audit tests LLIS-like correction memory against reported collection, sharing, use, and application barriers.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents source-infrastructure records from implying effectiveness merely from repository existence.
still_needed: positive-control case where a repository/recommendation measurably changed future practice
current LLIS or comparable present-day audit

entries.pattern_title: Candidate-mechanism plausibility can outrun denominator-scale association evidence
entries.why_it_fits: APOE ε4 provides a non-deterministic but durable gene/risk control, preventing psychiatric candidate-gene nulls from becoming anti-genetics doctrine.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents all-candidate-genes-fail overfit; forces risk-not-diagnosis and ancestry/scope cautions.

entries.pattern_title: Candidate-mechanism plausibility can outrun denominator-scale association evidence
entries.why_it_fits: HLA-B*5701/abacavir provides an actionable gene-drug control with screening and guideline evidence.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents the pattern from ignoring pharmacogenomic actionability when phenotype and intervention are tight.

entries.pattern_title: Candidate-mechanism plausibility can outrun denominator-scale association evidence
entries.why_it_fits: ADH1B/ALDH2 provide enzyme-pathway and population-scoped alcohol-response controls.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents conflating diffuse common-trait psychiatric candidate failures with tighter biochemical-pathway cases.

entries.pattern_title: Candidate-mechanism plausibility can outrun denominator-scale association evidence
entries.why_it_fits: HLA-B*15:02/carbamazepine is actionable yet ancestry-scoped and non-deterministic.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents both anti-pharmacogenomics and naive universal-transfer interpretations.

entries.pattern_title: Candidate-mechanism plausibility can outrun denominator-scale association evidence
entries.why_it_fits: PCSK9 provides a strong-effect human-genetic relation that survived as a major target-validation story.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents treating all candidate mechanisms as weak or failed.

entries.pattern_title: Evidence scope follows denominator diversity, portability, and governance
entries.why_it_fits: It shows a genetic relation can be clinically useful while explicitly population-scoped and imperfect.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents MKH-PAT-0016 from becoming a claim that narrow or ancestry-scoped evidence is always unusable.
still_needed: negative control where narrow evidence transfers robustly
positive control where diversity repair improves portability

entries.pattern_title: Extraordinary anomaly discipline requires instrument-chain audit, independent controls, versioned provenance, and scope narrowing
entries.why_it_fits: GW150914 provides a surviving extraordinary physical-science signal that passed network detection, statistical/significance tests, data release, and later public-data reanalysis.
entries.what_it_prevents_overclaiming: Prevents anomaly-discipline from becoming a false-alarm/debunking pattern; surprise can be earned into knowledge.
still_needed: negative control where public/open-data rails do not settle status

completion_state: controls remain partial; no pattern matured in rev0022
